The coasting effect is not associated with Cisplatin; it is related to other drugs, such as certain antibiotics. Additionally, while pulmonary fibrosis can occur as a side effect of some chemotherapeutic agents, it is more commonly associated with bleomycin rather than Cisplatin. Therefore, the correct answer is that Cisplatin does not produce the coasting effect.
